Monday.subject: English
Monday.title: Blend and segment words
activities: Sound and blend these words: sat, map, dog, sun and pin.
Use counters for each sound in cat, sit, mop, run and tap. Push the counters together and say the word.
Adult says: map, dog, sun, pin and cat. Child stretches each word and writes the sounds they hear.
challenges: Read these words without counters: stop, frog, clap.
Choose one word and write a short sentence using it.

Tuesday.subject: Mathematics
Tuesday.title: Addition and subtraction within 10
activities: Use toy cars to solve: 5 + 2, 6 - 2, 4 + 4 and 9 - 3.
challenges: Mia has 4 blocks and gets 3 more. How many blocks does she have?
There are 9 birds. 4 fly away. How many birds remain?

Wednesday.subject: English
Wednesday.title: Read and write a sentence
activities: Read: The dog can sit on the mat. Then write a new sentence about a cat.
Put these words in order: cat / the / sat / mat / on / the.
Look at a favourite toy and write one sentence about it. Check capital letter, spaces and full stop.
challenges: Write two sentences about the same picture.
Add a describing word to your sentence.

Thursday.subject: Mathematics
Thursday.title: Repeating patterns
activities: Continue: red, blue, red, blue, red, __, __.
Continue: star, star, triangle, star, star, triangle, __, __, __.
Use Lego or household objects to create an ABC repeating pattern.
challenges: Create your own repeating pattern and explain which part repeats.
Find the mistake: red, blue, red, blue, blue, red, blue. Fix the pattern.

Friday.subject: Science
Friday.title: Material detectives
activities: Find a plastic, metal and paper object. Describe each as smooth, rough, hard, soft, bendy or stiff.
Choose three household objects and group them by what material they are made from.
Compare a spoon and a paper towel. How are their materials different?
challenges: Why would paper be a poor material for making a drinking cup?
Choose the best material for a raincoat and explain why.

reading.question: How many words are in: The cat can sit.

sentence-writing.question: Which mark goes at the end of: The dog can run

patterns.question: What comes next: red, blue, red, blue, ___
What comes next: star, star, triangle, star, star, triangle, ___

materials.question: Is a metal spoon usually hard or soft?
